static_traits.name: Li Wenjing
static_traits.social_status: Having a few friends to talk to, but not yet discussing feelings of failure with them out of shame; difficulty connecting with colleagues, difficulty expressing low self-esteem
static_traits.medical_history: No major physical illness; no prior psychotherapy or psychiatric visits; never had similar self-esteem problems in the past
static_traits.language_features: Slightly nervous but willing to cooperate, clear and organized expression, able to describe own thoughts and emotions; Neutral attitude

basic_info.main_problem: I feel I am a failure, and because a recent encyclopedia sale failed to close, I believe I will never achieve my goal of becoming a top encyclopedia salesman; this Work incident significantly damaged my self-esteem, making me worry I will never be promoted to manager.
basic_info.core_demands: The impact of recent work events on my self-esteem has made me realize I need to seek counseling to cope with and change these negative thinking patterns.
growth_experiences: Significant Work setback: failing to close any sales in the recent encyclopedia pitch, stress was very high at the time, thus feeling major frustration, beginning to doubt my ability as a salesman, and worrying about being unable to be promoted to manager; since then when Facing challenging sales situations, negative Automatic thoughts recur, affecting Work performance at the gas station, relationships with colleagues, and sleep.

A failure experience in dance class: in one class, everyone else smoothly completed a movement combination while she kept making mistakes; since then she frequently compares herself with others, believes 'no matter how much I practice I can only be mediocre', and worries she will embarrass herself in class and be considered a poor dancer; although the teacher's feedback says she is improving, she still tends to regard positive information as 'just politeness out of duty'.

core_beliefs: I am not good enough, unable to reach others' level
One failure means I will never succeed / unable to be promoted

special_situations.event: Not closing a single deal recently when pitching encyclopedias
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I fail in sales, it proves I am not suited to be a salesman, and can never be promoted to manager
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Tries to boost confidence through positive self-suggestion and watching motivational videos
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I will surely never become a manager now / I am just a failure

special_situations.event: In dance class, other students successfully complete the movements while I make frequent mistakes
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I do not perform as well as my peers, I will be looked down on, meaning I am not good enough
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Making up for insufficiencies through more practice, while mentally negating positive feedback
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: Everyone will think I am a terrible Dancer

special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If unable to achieve good results immediately, it means total failure, lacking ability
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Reducing connection with colleagues, Suppressing expression of low self-esteem to avoid exposing insufficiencies
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I am going to fail again, this shows I am simply no good

special_situations.event: When thinking about talking with friends about his failures and shame
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: My value depends on others' recognition; if failure is exposed, I will be negated and looked down on
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Avoids discussing one's failures and shame with friends
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: They will look down on me / I am humiliated, better not to say

core_conflict.wish: Longing for recognition and success (becoming an excellent salesperson, obtaining promotion; being affirmed in the area of interest)
core_conflict.fear: Fears being humiliated and looked down on after failure, thereby losing worth and opportunities
defense_goal: Maintains the safety of self-esteem by avoiding exposing vulnerability and failure
Negating positive feedback with seemingly reasonable Interpretations, to reduce the pressure of being expected of or judged

object_relations.object_representation: Others are potential judges who will look down on oneself

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When others (such as the dance teacher or counselor) give positive evaluations or encouragement
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: She thinks the other is only acting out of duty or politeness, not genuinely recognizing her
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Gentle tone, not confrontational, inviting them to specify evidence; use probing questions to help distinguish 'duty politeness' from 'genuine feedback', while affirming their cautious attitude to lower defensiveness

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: Performing poorly in group settings (dance class, colleague groups) or When comparing oneself with others
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: She extrapolates self-criticism into others looking down on her (despite having no direct evidence)
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Maintain an accepting and curious tone, inviting them to distinguish facts from speculation, encouraging listing supporting and refuting evidence; avoid judgment, use open-ended questions

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When asked whether they share their failures and shame with friends or colleagues
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Believing revealing vulnerability leads to losing face or Being rejected, thus suppressing expression as much as possible
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Soft tone, slowed pace, prioritizing building safety; inviting sharing bearable fragments in small steps, use normalization and Empathy to reduce shame

manifestations: Unwilling to share feelings of failure with friends out of shame
After career-goal setbacks, doubts own worth and ability
Treating one failure as a permanent label
outcomes: Decreased drive and Work performance affected

contact_model.definition: The individual takes in external rules and expectations without digesting them, treating them as their own standards or absolute truths
manifestations: Uses 'must become a top encyclopedia salesperson / should succeed quickly' as self-standards
Equating one failure with permanent unqualifiedness

contact_model.definition: The individual attributes feelings they find hard to accept to others
manifestations: Worrying in dance class that others will think one is terrible, although no one says so

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact
manifestations: Treats positive feedback as 'politeness out of duty'

contact_model.definition: The individual restrains impulses to do something to others or things, or gives up seeking others to do something for them, turning to do it to oneself instead
manifestations: Not talking about failure and unease with friends out of shame, pressing emotions inward

positive_force: Has clear career goals and enthusiasm (proactively seeks to become an excellent salesperson)
Can persist in practice and learning (continues dance classes, willing to improve)
Has some social support resources (has a few friends to talk with)
Able to notice and describe his own thinking patterns and proactively seeks counseling help
negative_force: Negative cognitions such as catastrophizing, overgeneralization, and mind reading prominently dominate
Negating positive feedback, over-relying on external evaluation to define self-worth
Strong shame; tends to avoid communication and expressing vulnerability
Sleep disturbed and persistent worry affecting energy and performance
Difficulty connecting with colleagues, comparison and Self-monitoring in social interaction intensifying stress

target_behavior.behavior: Catastrophizing and failure-predicting automatic thoughts arise under sales or performance pressure
antecedent: Comparison when performing poorly in groups
target_behavior.core_reason: Overgeneralizes one failure into a permanent conclusion, and uses external evaluation as the core basis of self-worth
target_behavior.function: Escaping feelings of being judged and further failure, trying to maintain fragile self-esteem through Self-protection
target_behavior.consequence: Impaired self-esteem, Anxiety intensified, Decline in work performance, weakened career promotion expectations

target_behavior.behavior: Avoids communicating failure and shame with friends or colleagues
antecedent: Thinking about discussing failure experiences with friends
Feeling low self-esteem or discomfort when interacting with colleagues
target_behavior.core_reason: Shame and worry about others' negative evaluations (mind reading), with self-worth determined by external recognition
target_behavior.function: Avoiding embarrassment and possible negating evaluation, short-term Anxiety relief
target_behavior.consequence: Unable to obtain Social support, Loneliness and Negative emotions persisting, Sleep disturbed
